title: fix(ui): show total tool calls alongside failures
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: collapsed work summaries show failures without the total, making a mostly successful run look unsuccessful.

## User Impact

Users see **Worked · 200 tool calls · 20 failed**. Runs without failures still show the total; narration-only turns omit it. Duration labels and expandable details remain unchanged.

## Why This Change Was Made

The denominator gives failures context without asking users to add succeeded and failed counts. Prepared activity remains authoritative for its messages, while raw-only calls contribute without collapsing anonymous calls or double-counting identified call/result pairs.

Current main’s canonical skipped outcome now supplies the skipped count. The generic outcome list excludes both failed and skipped labels, so each appears once. Superseded local skip normalization and visibility handling were removed.

## Evidence

- **46 focused tests passed:** 32 summary regressions plus 14 duration/grouping cases. Three integration regressions first reproduced the duplicate skipped label, then passed after correction; coverage includes collapsed/expanded prepared skips and raw steering skips.
- **Changed-file checks passed** against main `6094db07240a`, including typechecks, lint, formatting, styles, i18n, dead-export checks, and repository guards. Validation used a clean current-base checkout whose full source tree exactly matched the integration candidate; the initial in-progress-merge comparison exceeded a Git output buffer rather than failing a code check.
- **Fresh independent P0–P2 review: no actionable findings.**
- **Current-head [CI passed](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36479902720)** for `17b22cbed3454`. [ClawSweeper review](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/157904#issuecomment-5827076851) rates it **platinum hermit (4/6)** with **no actionable findings**.

### Before

![Before: work summary shows only 20 failed calls](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0ec89395-8cbf-4bdf-a009-bb7bafff144b)

### After

![After: work summary shows 200 tool calls and 20 failed](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2d5f9333-4b5a-4da8-a03e-6bf0914602f1)

These inspected production Control UI captures use synthetic Gateway history. They show the original layout change, which is retained by the counting corrections. Desktop (1100 px), mobile (390 px), and disclosure expansion were checked during that capture; no live Gateway or deployment is claimed.

<details>
<summary>Test cost and integration scope</summary>

`pnpm test ui/src/pages/chat/components/chat-activity-disclosure.test.ts --maxWorkers=1`: 32 passing tests, **3.02 s wall time**. The related duration/grouping invocation passed 14 tests in **3.95 s wall time**. Hosted shared UI-unit shards completed in **413 s, 372 s, and 369 s** respectively; these are whole-job timings, not isolated per-file costs.

Main `6094db07240a892b38a6f78d8bbd56960390c800` was integrated to resolve the actual renderer/test conflicts and adopt its skipped-outcome contract. The net PR diff remains five UI/docs files. No configuration, stored-data, or public API changes.

</details>
